# ONNX Runtime Web

This directory contains the WebAssembly-only browser runtime files extracted
from `onnxruntime-web` version `1.27.0`.

- Project: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/onnxruntime-web
- License: MIT

Only these runtime assets are distributed:

- `ort.wasm.min.js`
- `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.mjs`
- `ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm`
